jobs.title: Head of Product – SAP (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.
That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.
We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

 The role 
We are looking for our first Head of Product. You own what Qorelo builds and why, and you build the product function around it. You lead our solution architects, the people who carry our SAP domain depth, you work hand in hand with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you report directly to the C-level.
This is a leadership role at an early-stage company, which means two things at once. You set product strategy and make the big roadmap calls together with the founders, and you still write the spec, sit in the customer workshop and draw the cut line when it matters. Your decisions show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.

 What you'll own 
• Product strategy. Where Qorelo goes across the transformation lifecycle, which problems we solve first and which we deliberately leave to others. You turn that into a roadmap the whole company understands.
• The roadmap and the calls behind it. You prioritise with evidence from customers, Proofs of Value and the market, and you can defend every call to the founders, to sales and to engineering.
• The product team. You lead our two solution architects today and grow the product team as we scale: hiring, coaching and setting the bar.
• Discovery with real users. Consultants, SAP leads and transformation teams use Qorelo inside live programmes. You and your team sit with them, see where the product wins and where it falls short, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes.
• Product in the sales cycle. You join key customer and partner conversations, shape Proofs of Value with sales, and make sure what we promise matches what we ship.
• The bridge between SAP and AI. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost, and together with our solution architects you make sure what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.
• Shipping and outcomes. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines and success metrics. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.

 What you need 
• 6+ years of professional experience, with deep hands-on SAP experience: S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area such as FI/CO, SD, MM or PP. Whether you come from SAP consulting, solution architecture or product at an SAP ecosystem software company, all of it counts.
• 4+ years in product: you've owned a B2B product and its roadmap end to end, prioritised with engineering and shipped to enterprise users. Title doesn't matter, ownership does.
• Experience leading people: you have led product managers, solution architects or consultants, and you want to keep building a team.
• A command of the SAP transformation lifecycle and SAP Activate deep enough to be credible with CIOs, Heads of SAP and senior consultants at enterprise clients.
• Strong AI curiosity: you've actually built or worked hands-on with LLM tooling and formed opinions about where it breaks.
• Comfort in an early-stage environment: ambiguity, speed, hands-on work alongside strategy.
• Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base, but not expected.
You might be a fit if
• You've sat inside an S/4HANA programme and thought "half of this should be software", and you can name which half.
• Consultants trust you on module questions and engineers trust you to write a clear spec.
You've taken a product from its first enterprise customers to something repeatable, and you know what you would do differently next time.
• You know the SAP tool landscape, from Cloud ALM to Signavio and LeanIX, and where the gaps between them are.
• You want your product decisions to run inside DAX 40 landscapes within weeks, not sit in a committee for quarters.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product (Head of International - Real Time Operations)
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

The Role

As Head of International – Real Time Operations, you will own the strategy and execution for expanding the Fusus platform into international markets. This role is central to ensuring that Fusus can compete, win, and deliver at scale outside the U.S., while remaining aligned with Axon’s broader global product strategy.

You will define the expansion and maturity model that ensures Fusus succeeds internationally, harmonizing requirements across regions while avoiding “parity for parity’s sake.” You will partner closely with sales leadership and new markets international leadership to understand tender pipelines and prioritize the right investments that enables Axon to win deals and delight customers, while balancing core deliverables and sustainability.

This position requires a leader who can both lead directly and influence without direct authority, working across product, engineering, sales, and program teams to set strategy, make tradeoffs, and align on execution.

Your Impact

  • Define the international product strategy for Fusus, balancing competitiveness, sustainability, and scalability.
  • Partner directly with international sales leadership to evaluate pipeline opportunities, shape tender responses, and prioritize engineering work to win deals.
  • Harmonize requirements across countries and regions, ensuring strategic parity with U.S. markets where necessary, while building features and capabilities that truly matter for international success.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and program leaders to ensure international deliverables are embedded in Axon’s global roadmap.
  • Ensure compliance with regional security, privacy, and data residency standards critical to customer trust and adoption.
  • Drive continuous improvement in tender readiness, adoption, and customer success metrics across regions.
  • Act as a champion for international customer and partner needs within RTO, ensuring they inform product priorities at all stages.

What You’ll Do

Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Reports to: SVP & General Manager

  • Build strong partnerships across Axon (devices, digital evidence, productivity solutions) to deliver integrated outcomes internationally.
  • Lead direct engagement with international customers, regulators, and partners to distill insights into product priorities.
  • Establish a clear execution path within 90 days that defines roadmap priorities and sequencing for international expansion.
  • Align with the Head of International (Core Products & New Markets) to ensure RTO’s global efforts are consistent with company-wide strategy.
  • Create frameworks and processes that balance local customization with global scale.
  • Serve as a visible leader and trusted advisor for RTO’s international strategy, both internally and externally.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, real-time operations, VSaaS, VMS, IoT, or public safety technology.
  • Proven success in international product leadership, including experience scaling platforms across multiple regions with diverse compliance and operational requirements.
  • Experience partnering with sales leadership on tender-driven opportunities, translating deal pipelines into prioritized product roadmaps.
  • Strong understanding of global compliance standards (privacy, data residency, security) and their impact on product delivery.

 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 About the role
 Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots.
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal.

 Own positioning and messaging execution . Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations.

 Build and maintain competitive intelligence . Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns.

 Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences.

 Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback.

 Drive product launches and releases . Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers.

 Fuel demand and thought leadership . Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives.

 Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging.

  
 What you'll bring
 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories.

 Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features.

 Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments.

 A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts.

 Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence.

 Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base.

 Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers.

 Category-defining work. Agentic process automation is being defined now, and you will shape how the market understands it.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Artificial 
 Help shape the future of specialty insurance 

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.
 We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.
 You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.
 We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.
 Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.
 About the role 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own outcomes end to end: framing the problem, shaping the smallest version that moves it, shipping it in collaboration with other teams, and proving whether it landed with our clients.
 We are currently scaling our Product offering so you’ll be joining an established team made up of product, insurance and technical experts to meet the demands of our growing client pipeline.
 This opportunity would be ideal for a Senior Product Manager who has worked in a scale-up previously, and wants to take on genuinely challenging problems in specialty insurance. It is a client-facing role: you will spend real time with clients in the specialty insurance and reinsurance market, and you will need to hold a position when a client's request and the right product decision diverge. This is a true 'hands-on' role, going beyond traditional backlog management or delivery coordination. You will also help us sharpen how the product team operates as we grow.
 Responsibilities 
 Work across discovery, delivery and optimisation: turn problems and opportunities into well-shaped work with a clear hypothesis, ship it, and improve what is already live. Set the standard for how this is done, so other product managers can learn from the work you produce.

 Decide what to build next and what to stop. Design the research and measurement that will answer the question in front of you, and show the reasoning behind each decision.

 Lead roadmap and delivery conversations with clients as a peer. Where a client's request and the right product decision diverge, hold the position and explain why.

 Hold scope to the smallest version that still moves the outcome, working with cross-functional teams to ship iterative enhancements, and coach that same discipline across the teams you work with.

 Own the roadmap for your client engagement and set its direction within company strategy. Agree priorities and timing with the VP of Product, and decide what to stop and why.

 Own a product initiative across your client engagement from start to finish, including its milestones and how you will know it has succeeded.

 Feed what you learn from your clients into our view of the target state for digital and connected insurance businesses.

 First Three Months 
 In the early days of your role, you’ll be expected to focus on:
 Building relationships across teams to support project success

 Leading discussions with both internal and external stakeholders

 Making sure everyone at Artificial is aligned on what is important

 Delivering against our continuous roadmap, and starting to form a view on how we'll know they've landed well with customers

 Forming direct relationships with external stakeholders

 Gaining meaningful insight into our current processes and ways of working that could benefit from fresh eyes

 Taking ownership of the work flowing through your area, and building the relationships and context needed to make the calls yourself.

 Strategic thinker with a business mindset

 Used to working in a fast-paced, technological environment, with all the ambiguities this presents: flexibility will be needed

jobs.title: Operations Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Unity Advisory. 
 Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.
 
 The Role 
 We are seeking a highly organised and delivery-oriented Operations Project Manager to join our growing internal operations team. You will work closely with senior leadership - including the COO - to support and drive cross-functional initiatives that scale our operations and improve internal efficiency.
 This is a hybrid role based out of our Mayfair office. It is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and is eager to take ownership of operational delivery while learning the mechanics of a rapidly growing advisory firm.
 In due course, the successful candidate will also have the opportunity to take on client-facing project responsibilities - supporting or leading engagements across our advisory offerings, including operating model design, AI-enabled transformation, finance optimisation and managed services.

 Responsibilities 
 
 What You’ll Do
 Manage and deliver internal strategic and operational projects from planning to execution (e.g. systems rollout, process improvement, knowledge management, resource planning).

 Work closely with the COO and other leaders to track key firm-wide initiatives, identify dependencies, and proactively manage risks and blockers.

 Build and maintain project plans, RAID logs, status updates and communication materials for internal stakeholders.

 Partner with business functions (e.g. Finance, People, Tech, Client Delivery) to ensure seamless coordination of operational workflows.

 Support continuous improvement across core business systems, knowledge tools, and operational governance - driving efficiencies and automation using technology and AI tools where feasible.

 Coordinate and document internal operating rhythms - standups, steering groups, retrospectives, etc.

 Support leadership with strategic planning cycles and key internal deliverables.

 In time, support or lead delivery of external client-facing engagements in line with Unity Advisory’s service offerings.

 Contribute to shaping a high-performing operations function that scales with the firm.

 
 What You Bring
 Demonstrable experience in operations, business management, or project delivery - ideally in a professional services or consulting environment.

 Strong project management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive outcomes at pace.

 High attention to detail and an ownership mindset; comfortable working independently and escalating where needed.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex information clearly.

 Collaborative, low-ego approach to working across teams and levels.

 Comfortable using modern productivity tools (e.g. Notion, Asana, Miro, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides).

 Familiarity with agile methodologies, OKRs or similar performance frameworks is a plus.

 Interest in working in a fast-scaling, AI-enabled professional services environment, with curiosity to understand the end-to-end operation of a modern, high-growth business.

 Nice to Have
 Experience in client-facing roles or a willingness to develop into one.

 Exposure to internal consulting, senior stakeholders (e.g. COO and senior management), or business transformation projects.

 Experience working in or with high-growth organisations or start-up/scale-up environments.

 Experience working with private equity.

 
 Working at Unity Advisory
 We offer a flexible and hybrid working environment, where individuals are empowered to drive impact. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the operational backbone of a modern advisory firm and gain exposure to both internal strategic delivery and external client engagements. You’ll be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that’s redefining what advisory can look like in the age of AI.
 
 Additional Information
 We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments or support when applying or arranging your interview.

PLEASE NOTE: We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Global Product Ops Excellence (All Genders)
jobs.description:
The role

From day one you’ll enable international coordination and implementation of strategic product priorities by creating, standardising and optimising processes across central and local physical product teams and other stakeholders. The role will require a mix of process improvement, change management, technical understanding, project management and stakeholder management skills. Not only will you be an ambassador of Product Operations Excellence, but also champion the value of process automation and optimization, to set a solid basis for growth.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the operating model: Diagnose end-to-end processes across central and local Product teams and adjacent functions (Procurement, FSQA, Production). 
  • Design and scale standards: Own process frameworks, SOPs and rollout "golden standards" that teams across markets adopt. Challenge and iterate existing policies and guidelines when they no longer fit the business.
  • Lead cross-market change: Drive organizational change across markets and functions, balancing central consistency with local needs. Build alignment with senior stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and ensure a constant flow of information.
  • Lead programs and automation: Own complex automation and tooling initiatives from a commercial perspective. Sign off on tooling designs and business cases, guide Tech teams on scope, edge cases and interdependencies, and take part in Steering Committees. On top of that, identify where AI can reshape Product Operations processes, build the business cases and prototypes, and deploy the successful tools across markets and teams. 
  • Lead under uncertainty: Scope and drive short- and long-term programs from broadly defined outcomes. Develop plan Bs and alternative solutions when priorities shift, and turn ambiguous problems into manageable, measurable workstreams.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years minimum experience in Product Operations or Operational/Process Excellence; passion for food or experience within Food/FMCG industry or consultancy is a plus
  • Recognized expertise in process excellence, change management and program delivery, with advanced knowledge of methodologies, current best practices and industry trends. You continuously challenge the status quo and bring new ideas to life.
  • Highly numerate and commercially minded, able to build rigorous, objective business cases and to judge technical designs with confidence.
  • A strong stakeholder leader who manages global and local stakeholders at all levels, aligns teams across markets, and communicates clearly to different audiences.
  • Autonomous and outcome-driven: you manage scope and timelines independently, prioritize relentlessly, and are comfortable being challenged on the soundness of your work.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, demanding and data-driven environment. 
  • Curious about AI and automation: you actively explore how AI can reshape processes, assess its impact rigorously, and lead teams to adopt it where it creates measurable value.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier university, preferably in business, management, operations or a related field. Six Sigma Belt or PMP certification is a big plus. 

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • 2 years contract.
  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Launch Manager - Beauty & Skin Care (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei Rosental Organics übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für neue Skincare-Produkte und Beauty Tools, vom Business Case über den Go-to-Market bis zur Performance nach dem Launch. Du verbindest Produkt, Customer Insight und Growth und arbeitest dafür eng mit Head of Product, Product Development, Marketing, E-Commerce und CEO zusammen. Dein Ziel sind nicht möglichst viele Launches, sondern Produkte, die Rosentals nächste Hero Products werden können. Du entwickelst für neue Produkte den kommerziellen Business Case, von Consumer Need und Marktpotenzial über Pricing, Target COGS und Marge bis zum Absatzpotenzial.

 
 Customer Insights, Reviews sowie Markt- und Social-Trends übersetzt du in klare Hero-Product-Konzepte. 

 Den gesamten Go-to-Market-Prozess ownst du. Produkt, Packaging, Claims, Creative, Content, E-Commerce und Marketing greifen zum Launch nahtlos ineinander. 

 Cross-funktionale Launch-Pläne, Critical Paths und Milestones steuerst du so, dass mindestens 90 % aller Milestones fristgerecht erreicht werden. 

 Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Creative entstehen unter deiner Führung Product Stories, Hooks, Claims und Proof Points, die überzeugen und Performance treiben. 

 Mit dem Launch bist du nicht fertig: Die ersten 30/60/90 Tage analysierst du anhand von Umsatz, Conversion, Reviews, Repeat, Marge und Customer Feedback und leitest konkrete Wachstumsmaßnahmen ab. 

 Du hast mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Product Management, Go-to-Market, Launch Management oder Growth im Beauty-, Skincare-, Consumer- oder D2C-Umfeld. 

 Mehrere physische Produkte hast du von der Idee bis zum Marktlaunch begleitet und kannst erklären, warum sie kommerziell funktioniert haben. 

 Consumer- und Product-Taste verbindest du mit solidem Verständnis für Pricing, Marge, Business Cases und Wachstum. 

 Komplexe cross-funktionale Projekte zu führen, Prioritäten zu setzen und Teams auf ein gemeinsames Ziel auszurichten, ist deine Stärke. 

 Du arbeitest hands-on, schnell und mit hoher Ownership und wartest nicht auf den nächsten Schritt von anderen. 

 Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1) und sehr gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.

What you’ll bring

 Our new Enterprise AI Product Owner will own the adoption and value of AI in how Legal 500 works.  Own the roadmap and prioritised backlog for our enterprise AI opportunities, recommending what to build or adopt, what not to, and why. You'll write clear user stories and acceptance criteria and hold a consistent line with senior stakeholders when demand exceeds capacity.

 Hands-on Microsoft Copilot experience: you've personally configured Copilot skills, agents or team workflows. Using Copilot, or overseeing someone else configuring it, isn't enough

 Strong product management skills: setting priorities, writing user stories, running a backlog and managing senior stakeholders well

 Experience of owning enterprise libraries or other centralised controls

 Experience of running enablement yourself: you've designed and delivered upskilling personally, without relying on an L&D team, and you're comfortable leading working groups

 
 Desirable 
 A genuine interest in enterprise efficiency and how people actually work, with a track record of bringing teams together on shared ways of working

 A background in internal transformation, process improvement or Microsoft 365/Copilot SME roles, ideally including evaluating, onboarding or governing other enterprise AI tools

 An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets or other knowledge

Product Design makes up almost half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, and engineering to solve real customer problems at scale.

 

We design for the "magic moments"

We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product is our personality. We blend research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.

Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.

The Operations Collective is where we design how help and customer support works at Monzo. We think holistically about the experience of getting support as a customer, and how that connects to the systems, tools, and people behind the scenes.

We’re focused on delivering effortless, tech-led support experiences that can scale as Monzo grows. That means understanding customer problems deeply, preventing support needs where possible, solving issues at their source within the product, and designing seamless journeys whether customers self-serve or speak to a customer support agent. 

AI and automation play a central role, empowering customers to resolve simpler issues independently, and equipping our operations teams with intelligent tools to handle more complex cases with confidence and speed. We design across the full ecosystem: customer journeys, internal platforms, routing, and the foundations that enable us to scale safely.

There’s a real opportunity to shape how help works across Monzo, end to end. 

 

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

  • Embedding the long-term design vision for support experiences at Monzo, shaping how customer-facing journeys, internal systems, and human service connect into one coherent ecosystem.
  • Leading large, end-to-end design initiatives across ambiguous problem spaces, spanning AI-enabled help experiences, internal tooling, and operational workflows.
  • Designing with a service mindset, understanding what happens beyond the interface and shaping the real-world impact of your design decisions.
  • Designing across touchpoints; from the app, to the phone, to human support.
  • Navigating tradeoffs and guiding strategic decisions in an opinionated way.
  • Coaching the other Ops Collective designers by helping them to embed the vision in their work, running design crits and supporting them to shape their work. 
  • Continuing to raise the bar for design craft and product excellence at Monzo, ensuring your work is a benchmark for quality and innovation across the organisation and our industry.
  • Partnering with cross-functional leaders to define and execute product strategies that translate into actionable plans you help build and ship.
  • Proactively addressing systemic challenges, reducing complexity, and creating better conditions for teams to deliver impactful work.
  • Acting as a visible ambassador for Design, sharing your work and its impact across the company to maintain Design’s place at the heart of Monzo.
  • Mentoring and levelling up designers across the discipline, fostering a culture of growth, collaboration, and belonging.

 

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re an expert in your craft, with deep expertise in a specific design discipline and strong foundational skills across all areas of product design.
  • You’re comfortable designing for AI and automation-enabled environments, and excited by the opportunities AI creates to rethink how services operate.
  • You have experience working on complex service ecosystems, where digital products connect to real-world operations, people, or logistics.
  • You’re passionate about improving how humans and technology work together, creating experiences that feel seamless to customers and empowering to the teams delivering support.
  • You have a proven track record of delivering high-impact design work that drives customer outcomes, influences company metrics, and achieves commercial goals.
  • You’ll have excellent visual, UI and interaction skills, and the ability to think through complex interaction design.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Gateway
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
 
 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
 
 AI is now part of almost every workflow built on n8n. But before a new user can build their first AI automation, they often hit a wall: sign up with a model provider, create an API key, add billing, and paste credentials into n8n. Many people never get past that step.
 
 The Relay team removes that wall. With Gateway credits, n8n Cloud users get leading AI models and services such as web search, scraping and document parsing built in, with no keys to manage. A new user can open a template or ask the AI assistant to build something, and it just works on day one.

 
 Make day-one success the default
 Own the Gateway credits experience end to end: from sign-up to first successful AI workflow or Agent, to ongoing usage.

 Remove credential friction across the product. Work with the Growth, Agents and n8n Assistant teams so new users land on services that work out of the box.

 Decide which models and services we offer, and how we price and package them for users..

 
 Build and run provider partnerships
 Own relationships with model and tool providers, from first conversation to signed deal.

 Lead commercial negotiations, including volume commitments, pricing and terms.

 Partner with Finance on commitment approvals and consumption forecasting.

 Decide when to add, expand or drop a provider, based on user demand, quality and cost.

 
 Shape the enterprise AI gateway
 Lead discovery with enterprise customers and prospects: platform teams, IT and security leads, and AI owners.

 Turn what you learn into a clear product strategy, and be honest about what to build, what to pause and what to stop.

 Define the core capabilities: virtual keys, budgets and spend limits, model access policies, usage reporting and audit.

 Consider how the gateway works for self-hosted and Cloud customers. Work closely with engineering and our Cloud team on deployment questions.

 Help define how the enterprise gateway is packaged and sold, together with Sales, Finance and leadership.

 
 Lead across teams
 Work with a dedicated engineering team, and with design, as one product team.

 Coordinate with teams that own nearby areas, such as identity and access management, governance, billing and the Cloud experience.

 Keep leadership, Sales and Customer Success informed, and bring them clear recommendations.

 
 REQUIREMENTS
 
 Must-haves 
 Experience as a PM for AI infrastructure, developer platforms or LLM tooling (for example AI gateways, model APIs, or AI platform products), or for enterprise admin and governance products (for example access control, policy, spend management or audit).

 Hands-on experience with partner or vendor deals: you have negotiated terms, not only managed relationships.

 A strong grasp of usage-based pricing, unit costs and consumption forecasting.

 Comfort talking with enterprise buyers: platform engineers, security teams and IT leaders.

 Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.

 Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.

 Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition 

 
 Nice-to-haves 
 You have built or run an LLM gateway or proxy, or worked closely with tools like LiteLLM, Portkey or similar.

 Experience with products that run both self-hosted and as SaaS.

 You’ve built products for technical users and understand what great developer and builder experiences look like.

jobs.title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über DrAnsay 
 DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.
 Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.
 
 Warum es diese Rolle gibt 
 DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.
 Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.
 
 Deine Rolle 
 Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.
 
 Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.
 
 Was du konkret machst 
 Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

 OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

 Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

 Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

 User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

 Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

 Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

 Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

 
 Das brauchst du 
 Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

 Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

 Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

 Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

 Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

 Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

 Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

 
 Das fällt positiv auf 
 Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

 Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

 Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

 Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

 Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

 Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

 Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

 Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von U

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About DeepJudge: 
 Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.
 Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.
 Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.
 Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.
 At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.
  
 About the role:
 DeepJudge is a fast-growing venture-backed startup at the forefront of applying Artificial Intelligence in the legal domain. Founded by ex-Googlers and ETH PhDs, our mission is to help legal teams harness their collective knowledge so they can focus on the strategic aspects of their work. DeepJudge’s state-of-the-art knowledge retrieval system directs legal professionals to the internal insights that matter most, providing a strong foundation for AI-powered workflows. We’re headquartered in Zurich, with a team in the United States and Canada, and cater to clients all around the world.
 We are looking for a thoughtful and strategic Product Marketing Manager to help shape how we communicate the value of AI-powered legal solutions to the market. As a subject matter expert on our products, you will craft compelling messaging, develop go-to-market strategies, and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure our positioning resonates with customers.
 This is an exciting opportunity for a marketer who is passionate about making complex technology approachable and valuable for legal professionals. You are a great fit for this role if you have a proven track record in B2B SaaS product marketing, a talent for crafting compelling messaging, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to drive product launches, customer adoption, and market success.
 

 What you’ll be doing 
 Craft compelling messaging and positioning that articulates the value of DeepJudge to our core audiences, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.

 Lead the launch of new features and products, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and engagement.

 Act as a proactive advocate for DeepJudge’s product by sharing product features, use cases, and insights across the company.

 Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams to create effective enablement materials and ensure alignment with strategic goals.

 Gather and synthesize customer and market insights to provide actionable feedback that informs product development and enhances product-market fit.

 Translate data and findings into actionable insights that drive decisions and fuel impactful product and feature updates.

 Collaborate with the Marketing team to support marketing campaigns for new product features and updates.

 Create, monitor, and analyze product marketing performance metrics to guide strategic actions.

 Use tools such as Hubspot, Figma, Webflow, Linear, and G Suite to manage projects, analyze data, and create content, with a focus on data-driven decision-making
 

 What we are looking for 
 3+ years of product marketing experience, in the B2B SaaS or technology space (legal tech strongly preferred but will consider experience within complex data/AI enterprise software space)

 Translate data into actionable insights, ensuring decisions are grounded in evidence, not assumptions

 Ability to work independently and in a team environment, managing multiple priorities with attention to detail

jobs.description:

 Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.
 Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.
 Tasks
 The Role 
 We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.
 This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 Main Responsibilities 
 Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

 Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

 Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

 Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

 Requirements
 Your Profile 
 Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

 Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

 Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

 Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

 An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

 A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Product Catalogue)
jobs.description:
Make Your Mark as a Senior Product Manager (Product Catalogue) at Storio Group 
 About the role 

Every product we sell, from photo books to calendars to canvases, is defined in our product model and catalogue. It sits under almost everything we do, and we are reshaping it as we move our ecommerce platform towards proven, bought capabilities. You will lead that work. Your customers are internal: the engineers, systems and teams who launch and sell our products every day. This is a platform role with real scope and real complexity, and we will be upfront about both.

 How you embrace curiosity daily 
 

 
 You own the roadmap for our product model, catalogue and platform capabilities, from first idea to measured impact.

 
 You untangle a grown, multi-brand landscape and turn it into something simple and self-service.

 
 You help shape what we buy, what we build and what we retire, with clear numbers behind each call.

 
 You work closely with engineers on trade-offs, and with product operations, marketing and production as true customers.

 
 You push back constructively when a one-off request should be a reusable capability.

 
 You use AI tools in your own workflow and across the product cycle, and you are curious about where they help and where they do not.

 How you make your mark 
 

 
 Teams launch new products faster, with fewer tickets and less manual work.

 
 You build a roadmap that balances platform health, delivery and commercial value.

 
 You bring people along the journey early, so nobody works in isolation.

 
 You turn deep system decisions into outcomes the business can see.

 What you bring to the team 
 

 
 5+ years as a Product Manager, ideally on platform or shared-service products.

 
 Experience with an ecommerce platform migration, ideally buy-led.

 
 Comfort with data models, APIs and integrations, and credibility with engineers.

 
 Strong data skills and a habit of making trade-offs visible with numbers.

 
 A bias for action, clear communication, and ease with ambiguity.

 
 Practical AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own work and know where they help and where they fail.

 What sets you apart 
 

 
 Product catalogue or PIM experience at scale.

 
 Exposure to personalised or configurable products.

 
 Experience evaluating commerce platforms or vendors.

 
 A background in photo, print or creative tools.

 About us 
 At Storio Group, we help people hold onto life's moments. We make personalised photo products that turn fleeting memories into things you can keep, share, and re-live. 
 

 Every person at Storio Group helps create our products and shape our company. You will see the impact of your work daily. We invite you to make your mark on our business, products, and customers' lives.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Traffic (Flow, Jams, Speed Profiles & Moderation)
jobs.description:
Introduction 
 Real-time traffic is at the heart of TomTom's mission to engineer the smartest, most useful map on the planet. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage. As Product Manager for Traffic Flow, Jams, and Speed Profiles, you will own a core part of TomTom's real-time traffic portfolio and set its multi-year roadmap, grounded in a deep understanding of traffic processing technology and customer needs. You will also own TomTom's traffic moderation tool — enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports, such as closures — running its user operations and prioritizing its feature roadmap.

 What you'll do 
 

 Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality.

 Own and operate TomTom's traffic moderation tool, enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports such as closures; run user operations and prioritize the tool's feature backlog.

 Bring a deep understanding of real-time traffic processing and jam detection, and use it to manage tradeoffs effectively.

 Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage.

 Lead brainstorms and drive product exploration through prototypes and wireframes.

 Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves.

 Data acumen — able to analyze data from multiple sources, such as GPS traces, probes, STOs, camera observations, and traffic authorities, to drive decisions and assess tradeoffs.

 Build strong cross-functional relationships and steer the product team by removing blockers and escalating appropriately.

 Communicate effectively to internal teams (automotive, navigation, delivery) and external stakeholders using customer problem statements and business logic; deliver concise presentations and lead meetings from standups to stakeholder reviews.

 Maintain product strategy and vision, and contribute to broader Traffic discussions; formulate compelling value propositions tied to articulated problems and product metrics.

 Establish yourself as the subject-matter expert and go-to person for live and historical traffic data products, maintaining trust across product and business teams with visible, citable personal impact.

 What you'll need 
 

 A minimum of 5 years' experience as a Product Manager, preferably in traffic, geospatial, mobility, or automotive domains.

 A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field.

 Familiarity with real-time data processing, GPS/probe data, or traffic and mobility analytics (preferred).

 Experience or technical training in data science, analytics, or related disciplines.

 Strong ability to understand, articulate, and represent customer needs and requirements.

 Proven ability to coordinate people and technical resources across multiple teams.

 Effective time management and strong interpersonal communication skills.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including with senior technical and executive audiences.

 Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 Strong problem-solving skills and creative, structured thinking.

 What we offer 
 

 A competitive compensation package, of course. 
 

 Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 
 

 Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. 
 

 Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.
 

 Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 
 

 Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. 
 

 Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 
 

 Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Product Catalogs
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands. 

Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems.

As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping. This role combines technical expertise, leadership abilities, and drive to understand and deliver on customer needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products
  • Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences
  • Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads
  • Establish and manage to SLAs within your team
  • Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team
  • Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in backend or full stack product development
  • 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams
  • You're highly technical, enough to solve almost any problem your team has yourself, but you prefer to guide your team into solving them.
  • Ability to work independently. You’ll be working with stakeholders that are mostly based in North America. You need to be able to make decisions and solve problems autonomously.
  • Excellent communication skills. You must be able to collaborate effectively with teams in a fully-remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.

Benefits:

  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Private Pension plan with Employer-matching
  • 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan
  • Income Replacement Programs
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager D365 CRM
jobs.description:
Digitale transformatie is pas echt succesvol wanneer strategie, technologie en mensen samenkomen. Als Senior Projectmanager bij HSO leid jij CRM-implementaties die organisaties helpen beter met hun klanten te werken. Je werkt met de nieuwste Microsoft Cloud-technologie en stuurt teams aan in uitdagende projecten. Daarbij combineer je overzicht, leiderschap en inhoudelijke betrokkenheid. Zo maak jij het verschil tussen een systeem implementeren en echte businessimpact realiseren

Taken
- Als Senior Projectmanager leid je Dynamics 365 CRM-implementaties bij onze klanten van start tot succesvolle livegang. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de voortgang, kwaliteit, scope en het budget van je projecten, en zorgt dat teams en stakeholders steeds dezelfde koers varen.
- Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en technologie. Samen met de klant vertaal je strategische doelen naar een duidelijke projectaanpak en een haalbare roadmap. Je begeleidt workshops, structureert requirements en zorgt dat CRM-processen zoals sales, marketing en service effectief worden ondersteund door Dynamics 365.
- Binnen het project stuur je een multidisciplinair team van (business) consultants, developers en solution architects aan. Je houdt overzicht over planning en afhankelijkheden, stuurt actief op risico’s en zorgt dat beslissingen tijdig worden genomen. Daarbij weet je complexe trajecten te structureren en verwachtingen van stakeholders op verschillende niveaus te managen.
- Onze projecten maken vaak deel uit van bredere Microsoft Cloud-transformaties, waarbij oplossingen zoals Dynamics 365 CRM, Field Service en Power BI samenkomen. In deze omgeving zorg jij voor structuur, richting en resultaat – en help je klanten niet alleen een systeem te implementeren, maar hun manier van werken daadwerkelijk te verbeteren.

Vereisten
- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met CRM-implementaties als Projectmanager - dit is essentieel!
- Je deelt onze mindset: kritisch denken, ondernemend zijn en resultaatgericht werken.
- Uitstekende beheersing van het Engels voor internationale projecten.
- Jouw managementvaardigheden zijn consultatief, anticiperend en inspirerend, waardoor het team effectief functioneert.
- Ervaring met het Microsoft-platform, met name Dynamics 365 CRM, is een pre.
- Aantoonbare kennis van projectmanagementmethodieken, zoals PRINCE2, PMI of IPMA C/D-certificering.

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden:
- Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;   
- 25 Vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;   
- Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal); 
- EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;   
- Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;   
En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

jobs.title: Product Manager Supply Chain & Transport - F/H
jobs.description:
Le Product Management, c’est notre ADN.

 
 Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes sur les produits digitaux qui tiennent leur chaîne d’approvisionnement debout. Référencement transporteurs, flux maritimes, routiers et ferroviaires, données critiques, maîtrise des coûts réels. Des sujets denses, peu spectaculaires vus de loin, et parmi les plus structurants qu’un Product Manager puisse porter.

 Ce que tu fais concrètement : 
 Tu pars du terrain avant de concevoir. Cartographie des flux de données, entretiens avec les coordinateurs transport parfois répartis sur plusieurs pays, identification des vrais irritants. Tu traduis ce qui remonte en parcours cibles, pas en liste de demandes.

 Tu portes une vision à deux ou trois ans. Tu construis la roadmap d’une plateforme de référencement et de pilotage : automatisation des appels d’offres, gestion des quotas, prévision des délais d’acheminement. Tu décides ce qu’on construit, et ce qu’on laisse tomber.

 Tu prends la donnée en main. Modèles interconnectés, qualité de la donnée, écarts entre coûts réels transporteurs et refacturation interne. Tu interprètes toi-même les indicateurs, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher.

 Tu pilotes le cadrage et la delivery. Briefs produit et scénarios d’usage pour ta squad technique, animation des rituels, validation de la conformité à chaque jalon, mise en service et formation des utilisateurs. Un outil historique ne disparaît que si le nouveau tient vraiment la route.

 Tu mesures l’impact. Réduction de la charge manuelle des équipes transport, fiabilisation des délais, tenue des coûts. Tu définis les KPI et les OKR qui comptent et tu les défends.

 Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d’expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

 Tu as déjà vu ce que l’automatisation des flux ou un algorithme de prévision change sur un produit supply chain ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l’IA partout.

 
 👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?
 
 Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l’IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

 Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

 Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.) 

 Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

 Le package : 42.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu’à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.
 

👉 Le profil que nous recherchons 
 Tu justifies d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager sur des produits digitaux avec un passage par la supply chain, la logistique, le transport international ou les référentiels de données critiques.

 Tu es à l’aise dans des architectures fonctionnelles denses et des modèles de données interconnectés, avec une exigence forte sur la qualité de la donnée. Le pilotage de roadmap et de backlog fait partie de ton quotidien, et ton orientation valeur est ton moteur.

 Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une communication capable d’embarquer des interlocuteurs internationaux et dispersés, et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

 Anglais professionnel attendu.

 Environnement technique que tu croiseras : Jira, Confluence, Figma, data lakes, API REST, écosystèmes ERP et TMS.

 Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ? 
 Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle
 Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager
 Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP
 Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche
 Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !
 Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog .

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION 
 To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.
 What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.
 In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.
 And we’re a long way from done!

 THE ROLE 
 Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be. 
 We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it. 
 This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. 
 If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.
  
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 
 Product Strategy & Execution: 
 Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why 

 Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value 

 Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour 

 Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics 

 Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

 
 Design & Engineering Partnership: 
 Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts 

 Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse 

 Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

 
 Cross-functional Leadership: 
 Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently 

 Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal 

 Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a consumer mobile app, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics 

 Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox 

 AI-native: you use AI tools daily, you have shipped or prototyped AI-powered features, and you have a clear point of view on where it adds real value for consumers 

 Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve as evidence comes in 

 A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about journeys, architecture and app quality 

 Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

 NICE TO HAVE 
 Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided consumer products 

 Familiarity with habit loops and engagement design in a consumer app: push, onboarding, personalisation

En synergie avec le Purchase COE (Center of Excellence), nous développons des produits comme ContextIQ, PYC et Datacost afin d'éclairer la stratégie d'achat par la donnée. Nous recherchons un·e Product Manager passionné·e par la valeur métier, la simplicité d'usage et les produits data pour piloter l'évolution de ContextIQ.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que Digital Product Manager sur ContextIQ, ta mission est de transformer les besoins complexes des acheteurs et acheteuses en une expérience produit fluide et un backlog clair et priorisé :

  • Vision et stratégie produit : Définir la feuille de route (roadmap), la vision produit et les indicateurs clés de succès (KPIs, adoption, valeur business délivrée).

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience confirmée en Digital Product Management, de la phase de discovery jusqu'au delivery continu.

  • Pratique des tests utilisateurs et du prototypage rapide (maîtrise d'outils type Figma appréciée).

  • Appétence ou expérience avérée dans le domaine des achats (Procurement), du price management ou de l'analyse de données.

  • Sensibilité aux enjeux d'intégration technique (API, flux de données) et à la gouvernance de la donnée.

  • Communication claire, esprit d'analyse et aisance dans un environnement collaboratif et évolutif.

STACK TECHNIQUE & ÉCOSYSTÈME
