 Own a section of qonto.com end-to-end: You'll be responsible for a defined part of the website — from identifying conversion problems to shipping the fixes. That means defining the strategy, running the sprints, and tracking the impact.

 Run a continuous experimentation cycle: Set up and analyse A/B tests using tools like AB Tasty or VWO, draw conclusions from GA4 and Contentsquare data, and iterate fast. You'll be expected to have tests running at all times.

 Align cross-functional stakeholders: You'll work weekly with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Legal, and the French market. Getting alignment without authority is part of the job.

 Promote Qonto's products on the website: Work with product teams to translate new features into compelling, conversion-optimised website experiences — landing pages, navigation flows, upsell surfaces.

 Benchmark and bring new ideas: Regularly analyse competitor websites and best-in-class B2B SaaS sites to identify opportunities Qonto hasn't tried yet.

 
 ➡️ What we're looking for 
 3-4 years of PM experience: You've shipped features end-to-end and can show the before/after on a metric. B2B SaaS or growth-focused product experience is a strong plus.

 Hands-on with web analytics and CRO tools: You've used GA4, Contentsquare, Hotjar, or equivalent. You can pull your own data, spot patterns, and build a hypothesis without waiting for an analyst.

 A/B testing methodology: You know how to size a test, define a success metric, and avoid common pitfalls (peeking, underpowered tests). You've run tests that failed and learned from them.

 Clear communicator across functions: You can write a crisp brief for a designer, explain a prioritisation call to a sceptical stakeholder, and present results to a non-technical audience.

 Working language: English and French fluency is required. Italian, Spanish, German or Dutch is a genuine plus given our 8-market scope.

 
 ➡️ What we can offer you 
 A website that is actually the product: At Qonto, qonto.com is not a marketing brochure — it's the #1 source of new customers. The PM who owns conversion has direct revenue impact, which means your work gets attention and resources.

 A real feature team: You'll work in a squad with dedicated Growth Engineers and Designers — daily standups, weekly sprints, shared OKRs. You're not a lone PM throwing specs over a wall.

 8 markets, real complexity: The website serves France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal, and Austria — with different regulatory contexts, languages, and user behaviours. That's a genuine product challenge, not a copy-paste localisation exercise.

 Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

You'll translate complex AP/procurement workflows (requisition-to-approval, three-way match, invoice capture, payment execution) into intuitive software built natively on Oracle NetSuite.   • Prototype fast with AI, then turn what works into requirements, user stories, and quality evals for AI features
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on GTM strategy and enablement
  • Ensure product logic meets global financial and tax compliance standards
  • Monitor performance and iterate based on data and customer feedback
  • Protect UX so complex workflows stay intuitive within NetSuite
  • Manage backlog, stakeholder alignment, UAT, and internal training
  • Use AI tools to summarize customer feedback from Support and Sales
  • Evaluate third-party integrations and support technical debt reduction

What You'll Need

Required

  • AI-native: builds with AI daily and has shipped AI/agentic features to production
  • 5+ years in Product Management within Fintech, ERP, or B2B SaaS, with direct P2P/AP/procurement ownership
  • Hands-on finance experience (practitioner or close partner to AP/procurement/controllership teams)
  • Track record taking roadmaps from discovery to launch
  • Experience owning a live, at-scale product — balancing new work against defects, escalations, and tech debt
  • Strong Agile/Scrum skills and familiarity with tools like Jira or Productboard
  • Proven success in fully remote, async, globally distributed teams
  • Excellent communicator, able to translate compliance logic into simple software

Preferred

  • Experience with Oracle NetSuite or a comparable native ERP platform
  • Familiarity with P2P/spend tools (Coupa, Ariba, Bill.com, Tipalti, AvidXchange, Ramp) and OCR/document capture
  • Understanding of multi-jurisdictional tax logic (VAT/GST/Sales Tax)
  • Finance/accounting/procurement certification (CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CPIM, etc.)
  • Experience scaling products in high-growth (Series C–D) environments

Benefits

We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

jobs.title: Product Owner / Business Analyst / AMOA (H/F)
jobs.description:
E-Finances développe et commercialise des logiciels de gestion financière utilisées par des entreprises en France et à l'international depuis 25 ans. Nos outils couvrent la gestion de trésorerie, les rapprochements bancaires et comptables, ainsi que la validation et la transmission sécurisée des paiements vers les banques (EBICS, SWIFT). 
 Nous cherchons un(e) Product Owner, Business Analyst ou AMOA pour prendre en charge le backlog fonctionnel de nos produits. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe R&D de quatre développeurs et vous êtes rattaché(e) au responsable R&D. 
 Ce que vous ferez 
 Organiser le backlog produit, proposer les priorités et le tenir à jour. 
 Qualifier les demandes et les anomalies remontées par le support et les clients, et proposer la suite à donner. 
 Rédiger des tickets clairs et complets (user stories, critères d'acceptation), prêts à être développés. 
 Écrire et tenir à jour les spécifications fonctionnelles et les règles métier. 
 Suivre l'évolution des normes bancaires et leur impact sur nos produits. 
 Animer les rituels agiles : daily, refinement, sprint planning, revue de sprint et rétrospective. 
 Préparer et réaliser les recettes fonctionnelles (tests manuels), puis coordonner les mises en production avec la R&D. 
 Documenter le paramétrage, en lien avec le support, et contribuer aux notes de version. 
 Contribuer à la feuille de route fonctionnelle des produits, avec le responsable R&D. 
 Vous êtes seul(e) sur ce rôle, mais pas isolé(e) : vous démarrez sur le produit principal, avec l'appui du responsable R&D et de collègues qui connaissent très bien les produits et les clients, puis vous élargissez progressivement votre périmètre. 
 Votre profil 
 Idéalement vous disposez d’expérience en gestion financière, incluant par exemple la gestion de trésorerie ou la comptabilité. 
 Vous avez aussi : 
 un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, à l'écrit comme à l'oral 
 l'envie de questionner les demandes et de proposer des solutions utiles aux clients 
 de la rigueur : vous vérifiez avant d'affirmer 
 de la curiosité pour le fonctionnement d'un logiciel : droits, données, paramétrage 
 une expérience en recette ou en test 
 la pratique de Jira et Confluence 
 l'habitude d'utiliser des outils d'IA au quotidien 
 l'anglais écrit, nos produits et leur documentation existent aussi en anglais 
 Pourquoi nous rejoindre 
 Des produits concrets, utilisés chaque jour par nos clients, dans un domaine exigeant (réglementation, sécurité). 
 Un rôle où vous avez la main sur l'organisation du backlog et de la documentation produit. 
 Une autonomie croissante dans les décisions fonctionnelles et la priorisation, à mesure que vous maîtrisez les produits. 
 Une équipe à taille humaine, avec des échanges directs avec la direction, la R&D, le consulting et le support. 
 Le processus de recrutement 
 Quatre étapes : 
 Un premier échange d'environ 30 minutes avec le responsable R&D & IT et le responsable consulting. 
 Une étude de cas sur place, d'environ 1h30. 
 Une rencontre avec l'équipe. 
 Un dernier échange avec la direction. 
 Infos pratiques 
 Contrat : CDI, statut cadre. 
 Lieu : Carquefou, en périphérie de Nantes. Une proximité géographique (moins d'une heure de trajet) est nécessaire pour venir régulièrement sur site.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Location: London (Next to East Croydon Station)
 Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days from home
 Reports to: CTO
 
 About Us
 Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.
 With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

 Role Overview
 You will be the product owner for one of our product teams. You own that team’s backlog, the discovery work behind it, the acceptance of what the team builds, and the conversations with the customers it is built for. You report to the CTO, and our product manager, who owns product strategy and the roadmap across the teams, supervises your work day to day.
 This is a product role first and a coding role second. You also generate code with AI tools, mostly on the front end, at roughly the level of a junior to mid-level engineer. We expect you to build working prototypes and small features that an engineer then takes over. We do not expect back-end work, architecture or being on call.
 Our teams are formed from the people we have at the time, so you are not being hired into a named team. You will work with the engineers in your team, the product manager, the CTO and our customer-facing colleagues.
 In your first year, you will get a team running on your backlog without the CTO or the product manager stepping in, and you will have personally shipped front-end changes and prototypes that engineers took forward.

 Key Responsibilities
 Own your team’s backlog: decide what goes in, what stays out and what comes next, and keep it in order.

 Run discovery with customers, so that what the team builds is something customers need and will use.

 Turn messy requests, rules and processes into small slices of work with precise acceptance criteria that an engineer can build and a customer can recognise.

 Accept the team’s work against the acceptance criteria.

 Say no, or reshape the request, when a customer asks for something that does not fit, and agree a next step with them.

 Build prototypes and small front-end features with AI tools, check what the tools produce, and hand the work to an engineer to take forward.

 Work with the product manager so that your backlog fits the roadmap, and tell them early when it does not.

 Who we’re looking for
 You have owned a team’s backlog. You decided what was built next and what was not, you accepted the work, and you can say what you decided and why.

 You have told a customer no, or changed what they asked for. You can say what they wanted, what you said and what happened next.

 You find out what customers need before building. You can show us a time you did discovery and what it changed.

 You turn messy requests, rules and processes into small slices with precise acceptance criteria. You can show us a time you did it, how you knew you had it right, and what you got wrong.

 You build working front-end prototypes or small features with AI tools, in the last 12 months, and an engineer took them forward. You can say what you built and what the engineer changed.

 You check what AI tools produce. You can describe a time the output was wrong and how you caught it.

 You work well with engineers: you hand work over clearly and accept the finished work against what you agreed.

 Knowledge of parking or of any one industry is welcome, but none of it is required.

 What We Offer
 Hybrid working, 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.

 Real ownership of a team’s backlog and its customer conversations, with a product manager alongside you.

 A small team and real influence over what we build.

 A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

 A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

jobs.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. 

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. 

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

 Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

 Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

 AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI.
 Its flagship product is Joker , Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates.
 For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham , the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable.

 🎯 What you will do 
 As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows.
 Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job.

 Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope.

 Juno is Joko's most ambitious bet: becoming the front door to shopping. An AI assistant that understands what someone is genuinely looking for, searches thousands of merchants at once, and gets them to the right decision in seconds rather than hours — the reflex people reach for before they buy anything.
 The Juno tribe is split into two task forces. Engine owns the assistant itself: the conversational experience users interact with, and the product logic that turns an intent into the right recommendation. Catalog owns the universal product catalog that powers it.
 Engine is where Juno meets the user. It owns the conversation itself: how someone expresses a vague intent, how the assistant narrows it down, and how a recommendation is presented so that it is actually trusted. Nobody has settled what a great shopping conversation looks like, so there are no patterns to borrow and the answers have to be found by building and testing.
 The task force is a small, autonomous team: a Product Manager who owns it, a Product Designer, and software engineers. This role is its first Product Manager, so the scope, the standards, and the way the team works are yours to define.

You will report to Yosr, who leads the Juno tribe, and work day to day with a Product Designer, software engineers, and the Catalog task force.
 Conversational product design : There is no market standard for what a great shopping conversation looks like. You will define it. That means testing a lot, iterating fast, and inventing interaction patterns for a surface that has none yet.

This is a large part of the craft in this role.

It also owns the Care experience and, importantly, performance and reliability across the board.

 🎯 What you will do 
 As Product Manager for the Core UX task force, you own it. That means a slice of Joko's core cross-platform experience end to end, with performance and reliability as a permanent thread. You will report to Damien , who leads the Scale tribe, and work with a Product Designer and software engineers.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Apaleo and the role

 Apaleo is hiring a senior Product Manager to own one product crew end to end, with real autonomy over what gets built and why.

 At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

 Your crew covers the daily workflows every hotel on Apaleo relies on: reservations and groups, guest and company profiles, front desk operations, folios and charges, finance and accounting, and reporting. You'll own the crew's strategy, discovery, prioritisation and delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design, and in step with the Product Manager who owns the wider product direction across crews.

 This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning, and you'll stay close to delivery, because shipping reliable improvements is still the core of the job. The role has no people management and covers a single crew.

 What you'll be up to

 
 Owning your crew's product strategy, roadmap, backlog and delivery within the agreed wider product direction, and measuring success by customer and operational outcomes rather than items shipped.

 Running customer discovery: interviewing users, reaching out to customers, spotting patterns across them and studying how competitors and the wider market solve the same problem.

 Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through with impact analysis.

 Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer.

 Working shoulder to shoulder with Engineering on technical trade-offs, dependencies, quality, reliability and maintainability, going deep on our API-first architecture.

 Balancing roadmap initiatives with operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and saying no to good ideas that aren't great ones.

 Defining success measures for your initiatives, then using customer feedback, product data and operational signals to judge impact and decide what comes next.

 Communicating progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers.

 Bringing your customers' needs, evidence and recommendations into wider product planning, and challenging existing assumptions where the evidence supports it.

 Spotting dependencies with neighbouring crews and product areas early, and resolving them together so customers get coherent end-to-end workflows.

 Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. Around 90% of our team's code is already written with tools like Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

 
 What you'll bring

 You have 5+ years as a Product Manager, including 3+ years owning a B2B or API-first product area, and you've run that area with limited day-to-day direction.

 Required experience and competencies 

 
 Independent product ownership. You've owned a product area from problem discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and measuring outcomes. You can tell us which decisions were yours and what you chose not to do.

 Customer centricity and sharp product judgement. You know how to run interviews, validate assumptions, bring in competitor and market insight, and turn patterns in customer pain points into clear opportunities. Customer centricity is central to this role.

 Technical depth. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions.

 Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value.

 Platform thinking. You weigh individual customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency, integration requirements and the long-term evolution of a shared platform.

 Clear stakeholder alignment. You bring Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers together, manage cross-crew dependencies and communicate trade-offs and decisions with confidence.

 An outcome mindset. You define meaningful success measures, write specs with a clear definition of done and use impact analysis to guide your next decisions.

 Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, use sound judgement, raise risks early and adapt to changing priorities without needing detailed direction.

 
 Nice to have 

 
 Direct ownership of a platform or API product with external consumers or integrations.

 Experience with developer experience, third-party integrations or platform ecosystems.

 Hospitality, PMS or hotel operations experience.

 Experience in transactional or finance-adjacent domains such as bookings, payments, billing, invoicing or accounting, where data integrity, consistency and correctness matter.

jobs.title: Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Product Manager – Finanzierung & Integrationen (m/w/d)

Die meisten Product-Rollen geben dir ein Backlog und ein Engineering-Team. Diese gibt dir zusätzlich einen Verhandlungstisch: Du überzeugst die Produktteams von Banken, ihr eigenes Engineering-Budget in eine Anbindung zu stecken. Danach gehört dir die Schnittstelle – auch nach dem Go-live.

 

Standort: Zentral in Berlin – Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro, hybrid mit 3 Tagen Office und 2 Tagen Homeoffice.

Über uns

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche.

 

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Anbindung unserer Finanzierungs- und Bankpartner – von der Anforderung über die Umsetzung mit Engineering bis zum Betrieb nach dem Go-live.
  • Du überzeugst die Produktteams unserer Partner, eigenes Engineering-Budget in die Integration zu investieren, und führst diese Gespräche bis zur Entscheidung.
  • Du analysierst, wo Händler zwischen Fahrzeugansicht und abgeschlossenem Gebot abspringen, und erhöhst die Conversion messbar.
  • Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, begründest jede Priorisierung damit und verfolgst die KPIs deiner Features nach dem Launch.
  • Du baust Prototypen, um eine Idee zu testen, bevor du Engineering-Zeit dafür einplanst.
  • Du sprichst regelmäßig mit Händlern, sammelst Feedback strukturiert ein und übersetzt es in konkrete Anforderungen.

 

Die Stelle ist eine Nachbesetzung in einer gewachsenen Produktorganisation – acht Product Manager, zehn Engineering-Teams.

Was du mitbringst

  • 3–6 Jahre im Produktmanagement in einem digitalen B2B-, Plattform- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, mit breitem Verantwortungsbereich
  • Du hast eine Funnel- oder Conversion-Kennzahl bewegt und kannst Ausgangswert und Ergebnis nennen – mit Daten, die du selbst gezogen hast
  • Erfahrung mit externen Partnern, deren Prioritäten du verstehen und beeinflussen musstest – nicht nur interne Stakeholder
  • Technisches Verständnis für API-Integrationen: Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln, aber verstehen, worüber Engineering spricht
  • Eine klare Vorstellung davon, wo KI diese Arbeit konkret besser macht – ob dein aktueller Arbeitgeber dir die Tools zur Verfügung stellt, spielt für uns keine Rolle
  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher

jobs.title: Product Manager Digital Platforms
jobs.description:
🌊 Who are we? 
 
We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.
 
 About the role
 AURA is the platform Aquablu runs on. It replaced about 15 tools with one system of record, gives every colleague their own AI agent, and connects to hundreds of our systems in the field. Version 2.0 just went live. What it becomes next is your call.
 
 You own AURA’s direction: what gets built, why, and in what order. Then you build it yourself. You’ll write features with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, and deploy them to production. Our engineering team sets the architecture, reviews your work, and makes sure the platform stays safe while you move fast.
 
 You don’t need to have been an engineer. You do need to want to ship code. You’ll report to our Head of Digital Product.
 
 What you'll Do
 Own the roadmap: prioritize by business value and user pain. Kill ideas that don’t earn their place.

 Find the real problem: work directly with the teams who use AURA every day.

 Build features yourself: go from idea to working feature with AI, not to a spec handed off to someone else.

 Deploy to production: ship your own features, with engineers reviewing and guiding your work.

 Keep leadership aligned: explain your priorities and trade-offs from decision to launch.

 Measure and iterate: define success for every feature, check whether it landed, and go again.

 
 What You Bring
 Platform experience: three to five years as a PM on a live software product, ideally B2B, SaaS, or internal platforms.

 Clear judgment: you commit when there’s no perfect answer.

 Stakeholder trust: you earn it with senior stakeholders and explain decisions plainly.

 Technical comfort: you’re comfortable with code, data models, and integrations, even if engineering was never your title.

 AI already in your work: you’ve built something with AI tools, even a prototype or side project, and you want to make it your day job.

 Bonus: connected hardware or IoT experience.
 
 ✨ Why join us? 
 You will be part of a young, fun and ambitious team which aims to change the way people consume water!

 🌴 26 paid holiday days

 💪 Urban Sports Club membership
 🚀 Access to the Corporate Benefits platform for endless savings
 🚆 Travel compensation >10km
 👴 A pension plan by Zwitserleven.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - 12 Month FTC
jobs.description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 12 month FTC.

 

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team for a 12-month maternity cover contract. It's an interesting time to join us. 

Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers' expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn't exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we're rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades. 

That means there are interesting product problems to solve - not just features to deliver. 

You'll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions. 

Although this is a fixed-term role, it isn't a caretaker role. You'll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it. 

How we work 

We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty. 

We don't expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions. 

You'll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them. 

You'll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something. 

And you'll make the team's thinking visible - explaining what we're trying to achieve, what we've learned, what we're uncertain about and why we're making the choices we are. 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll: 

  • Understand the problem. Build a deep understanding of our users, their needs and behaviours, as well as the organisational, operational and technical context surrounding them. 
  • Shape product direction. Work out where the greatest opportunities lie within your area and help translate PLOS's objectives into clear product outcomes and priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.
 
 

 About the Role 
 Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers
 already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers,
 technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly
 shape the value customers get from Perk.
 We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships.
 Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for
 generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product
 and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with.
 You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and
 manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work
 closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences.
 This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should
 work as we scale.

 What You’ll Do 
 Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI.

 Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences.

 Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations.

 Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

 Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value.

 Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals.

 Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers.

 Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows.

 What We’re Looking For 
 Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology.

 Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes.

 Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer.

 Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience.

 Strong relationship-building, negotiation

The training you build is used by aviation (civil and defence) professionals whose decisions keep people safe, so getting it right matters.
 You will work alongside some of the most respected subject matter experts in aviation safety, helping them turn deep technical knowledge into learning that is clear, engaging and works in the classroom, online and in blended formats. You will have real influence over how we design, develop and quality-assure our training, including how we use AI to do it better.
 If you have a background in learning design or training product development, a sharp eye for quality, and want to see your work make a visible difference, we would like to hear from you.
 Why this role matters
 This role owns the full lifecycle of a defined segment of our training and consulting portfolio. You will be the bridge between our subject matter experts and the wider business – sales, marketing and delivery – making sure every product is high-quality, ISO-compliant and commercially sound.
 Just as importantly, you will help make our portfolio more scalable, so that great products no longer depend on SMEs doing all of the development themselves.
 What you will do
 Own the product lifecycle: take a defined set of training and consulting products through design, development, QA, release and maintenance, delivering against timelines, budgets, quality standards and commercial goals.

 Identify learning needs: use training needs and gap analysis, customer insight and delivery feedback to shape new products and refresh and improve existing ones.

 Lead learning design with SMEs: turn expert knowledge into clear learning objectives, specifications, storyboards and design documentation.

 Shape new products: work with Business Development and SMEs to define market needs, build the case for new products and position them for sale.

 Create high-quality materials: presentations, workbooks, facilitator guides, lesson plans, marketing collateral and digital content.

 Champion quality: run QA, proofreading, brand, IP and publication checks before anything is released.

 Keep products current: manage version control, maintenance cycles and product KPIs.

 Improve the learner experience: raise the standard of design and usability across classroom, virtual and blended formats.

 Work smarter with AI: use AI tools to speed up development and reduce SME drafting time.

 
 What you will bring
 At least 2 years’ experience in training product development, instructional or learning design, or L&D content development.

 A track record of designing professional training materials for classroom, virtual or blended delivery.

 A solid grounding in learning design principles (for example ADDIE) and in training needs and gap analysis.

 A strong eye for quality and detail – you notice what others miss, from a weak learning objective to an inconsistent heading.

 Strong project management skills, and the ability to juggle several products, deadlines and stakeholders at once.

 Confidence working with subject matter experts: asking the right questions, challenging constructively, and turning expertise into effective learning.

 Advanced skills in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Adobe Acrobat.

 Excellent written English, to publication standard.

 Nice to have
 Experience in aviation, defence or another safety-critical or regulated industry.

 E-learning or blended learning development experience.

 A recognised L&D or instructional design qualification.

 An understanding of IP and contract frameworks.

 Experience using AI in content development.

 What success looks like
 90% or more of product milestones delivered on time.

 100% of releases meet QA, brand and IP standards.

 A 40% reduction in SME effort on repeatable development tasks.

 Fewer maintenance requests and releases each year.

 AI used effectively across the development process.

 Positive feedback from stakeholders and learners on usability and quality.

 Baines Simmons builds the competence behind aerospace and defence safety. For 25 years we have delivered expert, approachable training and consulting to civil and military aviation organisations worldwide: more than 750 organisations served, over 200,000 professionals trained, and 40 or more regulatory authorities advised.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a new challenge? 

 Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? 

 Prima could be the place for you. 

 Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. 
 

 To help fuel that growth, we need a Product Manager to join our Payments Domain .

 You will join the global Payments & Accounting product group, responsible for designing intuitive payment flows, seamless reconciliation systems, and high-accuracy reporting tools. Our mission is to abstract away technical and operational payment complexities, empowering Prima’s Sales, Customer Support and Finance teams with reliable, friction-free internal tooling.

 Excited to make an impact? Here are the details. 

 What you’ll do 
 

 
 Product definition : Identify, evaluate, and prioritise product opportunities by combining customer insights, business needs, and quantitative analysis, within payments and finance areas. Define and monitor success metrics, using data to continuously improve product performance

 
 Prioritization and planning: prioritising and planning the product development efforts, by partnering with the development team, product and business leaders

 
 Product delivery : collaborating with a cross-functional agile team to deliver on your plans, organising and taking part in the day-to-day work and making sure that everyone is working towards the same goals

 
 Stakeholder management : your stakeholders will include the finance, sales, pricing & underwriting departments, senior management and any Prima business area with an interest in the online sales flow. You will be responsible for gathering information about their needs and priorities, synthesising them in your product roadmap and specs, and keeping them updated and aligned

 What we’re looking for 
 

 
 At least 3 years of experience as product manager of software products working in a cross-functional team

 
 Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Engineering, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or another discipline with a strong quantitative foundation.

 
 Great verbal, and written communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate technically and strategically complex concepts to all audiences at all levels

 
 A pragmatic approach, the ability to thrive under the pressure of hitting targets

 
 A good understanding/awareness of data modelling and data implications when defining products

 
 Curiosity, ownership, and a continuous improvement mindset.

 Nice-to Have 
 

 
 Knowledge of the insurance sector or other regulated industries

 
 Experience with product analytics, experimentation, or A/B testing

 
 Familiarity with SQL, Python, or data visualisation tools

 
 Experience with AI tools to improve product discovery and delivery

 Why you’ll love it here 

 

 We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 

 

 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere. 
 

 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 

 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. 

 Think you’re a match? Apply now. 

 

 At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Dust 
 
 Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. 
 
 With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.
 
 With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. 
 
 We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.
 
 Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 .
 
 The Role 
 This is Dust's first PM hire. You'll work closely with the product team, turning raw GTM signal, company priorities, and user feedback into well-formed problems the team can act on.
 
 What you will change: 
 A lot of product signal doesn't reach the team in an actionable shape today. You'll create and run the process that connects signal to shaping to prioritization.

 Implementing company strategies across functions requires ownership and orchestration. You'll translate company priorities into an intelligible, trackable set of product, marketing, and operations initiatives.

 You'll enrich prioritized projects with distilled business and user context and market perspective so that the people building them make better decisions.

 Our designers and engineers stay close to product decisions from conception to delivery. You're here to make their context richer and their priorities sharper. You enable distributed ownership, you don't replace it.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Qualify and synthesize feedback : Sit at the intersection of GTM, users, and product. Turn high-volume, unstructured input into a small set of well-framed problems worth solving.

 Shape initiatives : Work with engineers and designers to translate validated problems into initiatives ready for Stack Rank — with clear objectives, KPIs, and scope.

 Drive outcome tracking : Own reporting on whether what shipped actually moved the needle. Feed that back into the next round of decisions.

 Improve internal coordination : Connect Marketing, Comms, GTM, and Product — reduce the friction that slows things down when multiple functions need to move together.

 Own outcomes, not outputs : For cross-functional initiatives, you'll own the goal — objectives, KPIs, orchestration, reporting.

 Own artefacts in the Dust platform (agents, skills, data, etc..) to continuously rewire and augment the above for yourself and the team

 
 What You Can Expect 
 
 Team 
 Dust is a growing team of about a 100 people. Most of the product and engineering team is based in Paris, with close collaboration across our teams in New York, San Francisco, and London.
 
 The interview process 
 The process is designed to understand how you think, collaborate, and operate in an ambiguous, technical environment:
 Recruiter conversation: motivation, background, logistics, and fit for an early-stage environment.

 Hiring DRI conversation: discussion with a senior member of the product team.

 Product exercise: collaboration exercise based on a real company priority.

 Founder conversation: discussion with one of our founders on product judgment, attitude, and ability to operate with distributed authority.

 Onsite: working sessions with members of Engineering, Design, and GTM. We’ll look at how you gather context, identify the important problems, collaborate on possible approaches, and leave ownership with the people closest to the work.

 We care more about the quality of your reasoning and collaboration than about arriving at a predetermined answer.
 
 What We're Looking For 
 Founding PM mentality: Senior individual contributor and builder balancing capacity to build the practice in the company while being hands-on.

 5–8+ years of product experience, including time at an early-stage company where you had to build process from scratch.

 Genuine product taste. You know great from good in the world of tech products, and you bring deep perspective, judgment and conviction to any preferences you voice.

 Excellent information synthesis skills, distilling a messy pile of customer feedback, sales calls, and Slack threads into sharp problems.

 Technical proficiency earn the respect of engineers. You don't need to code, but you understand systems and tradeoffs easily deeply.

 Builder mindset at heart. You use AI tools fluently and you're excited about what they unlock for how PMs operate. You've thrived in environments where everyone is a builder and you want to strengthen that.

 Effective communication. You'd rather say one clear thing than three vague thi

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
Odaseva provides enterprise data management and security solutions that help organizations exercise sovereignty over their critical data.

 Companies representing 10% of global market capitalization trust Odaseva, including Schneider Electric, Volkswagen and Robert Half.

 Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors.

 The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration.

 Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security.

 With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users. 
 

 
 About the Role: 

 As a Technical Product Owner, you will be the driving force behind the delivery and lifecycle of our product features. Working within an Agile engineering team and partnering closely with our Tech Lead/Architect, you will act as the essential link between our customer-facing Product Managers and the development team.

 While the Tech Lead drives architectural decisions and manages the engineers, you will take full ownership of the team's backlog, feature planning, and post-deployment success.

 Because our current technical leadership leans heavily into complex systems architecture, we are looking for a proactive, communicative leader to champion Agile processes and cross-team relationships.

 This role is perfect for a product-minded technical expert who enjoys being hands-on—regularly contributing to code and prototypes—while ensuring seamless delivery and alignment across the organization.

 Key Responsibilities 
 

 
 Take end-to-end ownership of feature delivery and product health , managing pre-release planning, priorities, and timelines, as well as post-release success, including deployment coordination, feature activation, and production monitoring.

 
 Act as the definitive technical bridge between non-technical stakeholders and developers , actively participating in and contributing to Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Refinement, Review) to ensure continuous alignment, clear communication, and team momentum.

 
 Partner closely with strategic Product Managers to understand business roadmaps, translating high-level business goals into well-defined epics and user stories.

 
 Own, prioritize, and maintain the sprint backlog , partnering with the PMs, Tech Lead and Infrastructure teams to balance new feature delivery against technical debt, optimizations, and scalability.

 
 Serve as the primary liaison for internal teams (Support, Customer Success, Expert Services) to field product inquiries, triage and investigate production bugs, and gather operational feedback to continually improve the product.

 
 Contribute hands-on to code and technical initiatives , rolling up your sleeves to build prototypes, develop proof-of-concepts, and assist in technical investigations across our polyglot stack (spanning diverse frontend and backend environments).

 
 Collaborate closely with the QA team to define robust Acceptance Criteria and evaluate completed sprint deliverables, ensuring everything meets quality benchmarks and the team's Definition of Done.

 
 Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to optimize Agile workflows, draft user stories, analyze backlog health, and streamline cross-functional communication.

 Required qualifications 
 

 
 10+ years of experience in the software industry, ideally transitioning from an engineering role into a Product Owner or Technical Program Manager.

 
 Proven track record of successfully managing technical backlogs, delivering complex projects, and demonstrating measurable impact on product performance or stability.

 
 Deep understanding of API design, system architecture, database interactions, and object-oriented programming principles.

 
 Ability to use AI tools across the product lifecycle (requirement analysis, story generation, acceptance testing definition, and workflow automations).

 
 Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and enterprise integrations (e.g., Salesforce).

 
 Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee technical bottlenecks and effectively sequence development work.

 
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to "translate" between business-focused Product Managers and deeply technical engineering teams.

 
 Self-motivated and proactive, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and optimize team delivery.

 
 Fluent in English and French

 Why Join Us? 
 We offer a challenging environment where your contributions will be highly valued.

 You'll have the opportunity to guide the development of critical and non-critical systems, collaborate with talented individuals across Product and Engineering, and directly influence the technical success and scalability of our products.

 Where You'll Be 
 

 Based in Paris (75002), Fr

jobs.title: Business Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Who Are We ? 
 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. 
 Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.
 At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.
 Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.
 We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 
 💼 About This Role 
 We are looking for a Business Product Owner to join our team and act as a mini-CEO for one of our key markets, taking full ownership of its performance and growth. You will play a crucial role in establishing and maintaining our products' market leadership, driving product expansion, and enhancing operational efficiency.
 🎖️What success looks like 
 In your first month 
 You understand our product, customers, and operational landscape; how value is created, delivered, and scaled and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

 You establish strong working relationships with the Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.

 By 3 months 
 Alongside our Product Owner, you contribute to defining a clear product vision and strategy, grounded in customer needs and market realities.

 You analyse product workflows and cost structures to improve efficiency and reduce time-to-market without sacrificing product quality.

 You coordinate cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to ensure efficient and well-executed go-lives.

 You become the main point of contact for our customers and engage directly with them, turning feedback into clear, actionable insights.

 By 6 months 
 You proactively drive product and operational improvements that measurably impact efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction.

 You influence roadmap decisions through market research, competitive analysis, and customer data.

 You streamline customer support and success processes to improve response times and long-term customer health.

 You’re trusted as a key partner across teams – shaping how we scale, not just what we build.

 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful: 
 You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.

 You bring 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or similar roles within a B2B environment, ideally in SaaS.

 You are fluent in English. Proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

 With the strong background in client-facing roles you bring, you know how to engage stakeholders at every level, bridging the gap between technical execution and executive leadership.

 You have an interest in software development, are eager to learn new tools and technologies, and bring basic coding experience.

 You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

 You put the customer first, anticipate their needs, and focus on delivering solutions that improve satisfaction and the overall experience.

 You are based in Munich and able to work from the office 3 days per week.

 💡It’s a Plus If You Have 
 Previous experience in the logistics industry.

 We don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

 A buddy system to support you during your first 2 months.

 Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

 We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

jobs.title: Product Owner (m|w|d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle bei uns

 Als Product Owner übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle zwischen Fachbereich, Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteam. Du arbeitest dich schnell in komplexe Geschäftsprozesse ein, strukturierst fachliche Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass daraus tragfähige, nutzerorientierte und wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Softwarelösungen entstehen.
Dabei behältst du Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, technische Abhängigkeiten und Projektziele im Blick, setzt klare Prioritäten und schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis zwischen Business und Entwicklung.
 Hör dir unseren Podcast Product Owner:innen im Alltag an! 

 Aufgaben

 
 Du analysierst, strukturierst und spezifizierst fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.

 Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, identifizierst die zugrunde liegenden Nutzer- und Geschäftsprobleme und leitest daraus passende Lösungsoptionen ab.

 Du priorisierst und pflegst das Product Backlog unter Berücksichtigung von Nutzen, Scope, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.

 Du übersetzt komplexe fachliche Anforderungen in verständliche und umsetzbare Aufgaben, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien für das Entwicklungsteam.

 Du moderierst Workshops und Abstimmungen mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklung, UX/UI, Architektur und weiteren Stakeholdern.

 Du sorgst für Transparenz bei Anforderungen, Prioritäten und fachlichen Zielen und beziehst relevantes Nutzer- und Stakeholderfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung ein.

 Du begleitest Refinements, Sprint Plannings, Reviews und fachliche Abnahmen.

 Du bereitest Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor, kommunizierst Zielkonflikte transparent und erkennst Risiken sowie Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig.

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Digitalisierungsumfeld.

 Du kannst komplexe fachliche Anforderungen analysieren, strukturieren und adressatengerecht aufbereiten.

 Du bewertest Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und leitest daraus fundierte Prioritäten und Entscheidungen ab.

 Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen fachlichen und technischen Umfeldern und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Geschäftsprozesse ein.

 Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis moderner Softwareentwicklung mit und vermittelst souverän zwischen Fachbereich und Entwicklung.

 Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern, verstehst Nutzerbedürfnisse und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und entwickelst auch bei unterschiedlichen Interessen tragfähige Lösungen.

 Du hast Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen sowie idealerweise mit Jira und Confluence.

 Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und mit einem hohen Maß an Selbstorganisation.

 Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau).

 
 Benefits

 
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten

 Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten inkl. Übernahme von Weiterbildungskosten

 Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

 Individuelle Entfaltung und ein respektvolles Miteinander

 Offene Unternehmenskultur, angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre & regelmäßige Teamevents

 Langfristige Perspektiven, betriebliche Altersvorsorge & Krankenversicherung

 Mehr Work-Life-Balance durch eine Kooperation mit unserem Partner voiio

 Wahlweise Zuschuss zu Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft oder BVG Ticket

 Inanspruchnahme von Rabatten über unseren Partner Corporate Benefit

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is taking on the hyperscalers by building a vertically integrated GenAI cloud platform. We own the data centres, software, and applications that power today's AI stack using sustainable technology solutions. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Collaboration is key, and we work together swiftly and respectfully, embracing adaptability and resilience in all we do.

About the role

Product Managers at Nscale own the definition, delivery, and ongoing evolution of a part of the Nscale cloud platform. You partner closely with engineering, design, research, and go-to-market teams to translate customer problems and business goals into shippable product outcomes. PMs work across the full breadth of the Nscale cloud, from core infrastructure primitives to managed platform services, developer experience, and internal tools, wherever product leverage is needed.

As a Senior Product Manager, you operate at team scope. In this role, you will own a major area of the cloud platform and drive end-to-end projects, from problem framing through launch and iteration, delivered within the EU and tailored to the needs of European customers and regulatory requirements. Equally central to the role is a deep grounding in cloud and platform technologies, with a particular focus on things such as security, compliance, and cryptography, which sit at the heart of how Nscale earns the trust of European customers.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for a significant part of the cloud platform within your team.
  • Lead end-to-end, cross-functional projects across the EU, from problem framing through launch, measurement, and iteration.
  • Deliver product outcomes that meet the needs of European customers, including data residency, sovereignty, and regulatory requirements.
  • Embed security, compliance, and cryptography into your product area, ensuring platform technologies meet the highest standards.
  • Drive meaningful ambiguity: clarify unclear problem statements, align stakeholders, and define what "done" looks like.
  • Partner with design and research to shape deep product experiences and validate hypotheses before committing engineering resources.
  • Mentor junior product managers and raise the quality bar for PRDs, reviews, and product decisions across the team.
  • Represent your product area in planning, reviews, and leadership updates.
  • Define and drive the metrics that matter for your area.

What you need

  • 5–8 years of product management experience in software or technology, with a track record of owning significant product areas.
  • Strong technical fluency: you can lead discussions with engineering on architecture, trade-offs, and feasibility.
  • Strong familiarity with cloud and platform technologies, with a focus on security, compliance, and cryptography.
  • Demonstrated ability to move from an ambiguous problem space to shipped product outcomes.
  • Experience mentoring or informally leading peers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you can make complex product decisions legible to a broad audience.

Nice to haves

  • Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or prior experience as an engineer.
  • Experience in cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, enterprise software, or AI/ML products.
  • Familiarity with the EU technology landscape, including data residency, sovereignty, and regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, EU AI Act).
  • Experience operating in high-growth or early-stage environments.

Join Nscale as we build a world-class AI cloud platform. If you're excited about owning a meaningful product area and raising the bar for the team around you, we'd love to hear from you!

 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (Legal Tech)
jobs.description:
About DeepJudge: 
 Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.
 Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.
 Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.
 Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.
 At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.
  
 About the role:
 DeepJudge is a fast-growing venture-backed startup at the forefront of applying Artificial Intelligence in the legal domain. Founded by ex-Googlers and ETH PhDs, our mission is to help legal teams harness their collective knowledge so they can focus on the strategic aspects of their work. DeepJudge’s state-of-the-art knowledge retrieval system directs legal professionals to the internal insights that matter most, providing a strong foundation for AI-powered workflows. We’re headquartered in Zurich, with a team in the United States and Canada, and cater to clients all around the world.
 
 We are looking for a thoughtful and strategic Product Marketing Manager to help shape how we communicate the value of AI-powered legal solutions to the market. As a subject matter expert on our products, you will craft compelling messaging, develop go-to-market strategies, and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure our positioning resonates with customers.
 
 This is an exciting opportunity for a marketer who is passionate about making complex technology approachable and valuable for legal professionals. You are a great fit for this role if you have a proven track record in B2B SaaS product marketing, a talent for crafting compelling messaging, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to drive product launches, customer adoption, and market success.
 

 What you’ll be doing 
 Craft compelling messaging and positioning that articulates the value of DeepJudge to our core audiences, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.

 Lead the launch of new features and products, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and engagement.

 Act as a proactive advocate for DeepJudge’s product by sharing product features, use cases, and insights across the company.

 Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams to create effective enablement materials and ensure alignment with strategic goals.

 Owning and maintaining integrated lifecycle plans for complex Level 2 and Level 4 product milestones, creating a clear source of truth across teams.

 You have the technical depth to work closely with engineers, evaluate complex system architectures and challenge delivery plans constructively—not simply track execution.

 You think in systems, understanding how technical decisions, dependencies and changes in one area affect downstream teams and product outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄

Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.

About the role

The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.

You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification

  • Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.
  • Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.
  • Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?

Business Cases and Strategy

  • Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.
  • Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.
  • Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.

Product Discovery and Delivery

  • Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.
  • Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.
  • Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.

Alignment and Stakeholder Management

  • Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.
  • Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.
  • Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.
  • Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED 🪄

Must-haves

  • Digital advertising foundations: supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.
  • Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.
  • High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.
  • Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.
  • Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.

We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. This role will focus on building, enhancing, and managing our technical products, working with our team to define and deliver solutions that support our mission of seamless, out-of-the-box space communication systems.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.

As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area. 

Who We Want 

Hungry learner
You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months.

Structured self-starter
You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance.

Analytical thinker
You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights.

Customer-curious
You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways.

Clear communicator
You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars.

Scrappy generalist
You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you".

AI-native
You use AI tools daily to work faster and better - from research and data analysis to drafting content and slides - and you're always experimenting with new ones.

Has taste
You have a strong sense for what good looks like in product, design and writing, and you notice when something feels off, even if it's "technically fine".

Language
You're fluent in English, written and spoken.

Who We Don't Want 

  • You only want "pure PM" work like roadmaps and specs and aren't interested in marketing or customer-facing tasks
  • You need a lot of structure and clear processes to be productive
  • You struggle to communicate clearly in English, in writing or in front of an audience
  • You get defensive when receiving feedback
  • You see this mainly as a title step rather than a chance to learn and get hands-on

Your Day to Day 

Strategic Projects (~25%)

  • Work directly with our CPO on the topics that matter most right now
  • Prepare leadership meetings, drive decisions forward and make sure priorities turn into results

Product Marketing & Launches (~35%)

  • Plan and run initiatives that bring our product to customers: webinars, product updates, customer events, newsletters and educational content
  • Prepare and launch new features end-to-end together with Product, Engineering and Marke

 BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing.

 You
